policy.selection_source: unset: fixed default (settings.json has no ocr_engine (fixed default))
policy.fixed_primary_law: the primary is FIXED to one of the two named release choices: the pinned PaddleOCR pipeline (recommended; a page Paddle cannot read falls back to Tesseract automatically) or Tesseract-only (the Paddle pipeline is never probed or loaded). Arbitrary engine/repository pins were removed with the model manager (final decision 2026-11-22).
policy.allow_gpu_default_reason: GPU placement is PREFERRED by default (B5 final decision 2026-11-22: GPU preferred for Paddle; the pinned OCR runtime is the CUDA 12.6 build, and the preparation manifest records the paddle.device probe for the build actually installed). This gate only lets GPU be CONSIDERED: devices.device_plan places the job from MEASURED free VRAM and places it on CPU when the GPU cannot safely proceed, so GPU is never enabled by borrowing the main LLM's device. RUKE_OCR_ALLOW_GPU=0 closes the gate; on a CPU-fallback build the gate has nothing to open.
policy.allow_unload_default_reason: the coordinated handoff is the configured deployment policy, not an acceptance-script flag: it is automatic when the measured resources do not fit alongside the resident main model AND the provider answers a validated unload/load lifecycle. It is switched off with RUKE_LLM_AUTOMATIC_HANDOFF=0; the legacy per-run override RUKE_OCR_ALLOW_UNLOAD=1/0 still wins over the configured default. Unloading is never taken when the job already fits, never while a turn is running, and never against a provider whose lifecycle calls are unvalidated.
policy.source: primary/gpu: env(RUKE_OCR_PRIMARY/RUKE_OCR_ALLOW_GPU); handoff policy: ruke_ml.models.provider_config (settings.json > env > .env.local > default)
